rebuttal_or_critique: While I firmly believe that a neutral stance is more appropriate given that core inflation at 3.60% is well below the target and the real policy rate is already in positive territory, I recognize the committee's collective emphasis on the risks posed by food inflation at 8.30% and the need to anchor expectations. To ensure a unified message that maintains the credibility of the MPC in the face of supply-side volatility, I am willing to align with the majority on the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance, while continuing to emphasize that monetary policy must remain data-dependent and avoid overtightening that could stifle the 6.80% GVA growth momentum.
